name: gridiron-physics
description: Physics-based 22-player reconstruction of a real NFL game from ESPN play-by-play, with a Madden-style rating engine grounded in public research.

scripts.data: python3 pipeline/fetch.py && python3 pipeline/ratings.py && python3 pipeline/build_game.py
scripts.test: node test/validate.mjs --strict && node test/prototype.mjs && python3 test/test_prototype_data.py && npm run test:autonomous
scripts.test:autonomous: node test/autonomous-schema.mjs && node test/autonomous-run.mjs && node test/autonomous-pass.mjs && node test/autonomous-perception.mjs && node test/autonomous-sightline.mjs && node test/autonomous-belief-boundary.mjs && node test/autonomous-formation.mjs && node test/autonomous-contact.mjs && node test/autonomous-rules.mjs && node test/autonomous-acceptance.mjs && node test/autonomous-results.mjs && node scripts/batch-autonomous-runs.mjs
scripts.test:week7: node test/week7-core.mjs && node test/week7-audit.mjs && node test/week7-audit-mutations.mjs
